<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate 82^9
result = 82 ** 9

# Get the sum of decimal digits

print(f"Sum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
